However, no on-page text or breadcrumb confirms these 14 items are specifically 'recently added to the catalogue' as opposed to a themed/named design-range showcase -- so it is flagged for manual review per the brief's ambiguous-Collection-page rule rather than silently included or excluded. Checked and EXCLUDED as a false-positive keyword match: /collections/modular-beds-new (H1 'Modular Beds New', 33 products) -- this is an ordinary furniture sub-category (a bed-design line named 'New'), not a New-Arrivals merchandising concept; excluded because 'new' here names a product line, not recency of catalogue addition. No overarching parent 'New Arrivals' page nests these two listings as children (they are unrelated, non-overlapping sibling listings), so both are emitted as flat rows, no is_group. No Claude-in-Chrome needed; tier 1 (direct HTTP) sufficed throughout.
